meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需编排镜头与动态元素,产出多场景视频、品牌宣传片或混剪成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做较长的多场景视频或宣传片,却没有现成的专用流程可用
copy.tagline_en: Compose scenes and motion to produce multi-scene videos, brand reels, or remixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a longer multi-scene video but no specialized workflow fits

howto.what: 用 HyperFrames 创作或编辑自定义视频合成:多场景长片、品牌片、蒙太奇、静态循环、静态标题卡、素材重剪等。它会先写 BRIEF.md,再规划各场景,加载媒体与动画规则后按依赖顺序构建。
howto.when: 当没有专门工作流可用,或 BRIEF.md 里 flow 设为 companion 时接管;短片、无旁白、以动效为主的单元改用 motion-graphics,全新创作先经 hyperframes 路由。

say.text: 帮我做一支三场景的品牌宣传短片,大约 30 秒
say.note: 会先写 BRIEF.md 并列出每个场景的规划。

say.text: 把这段素材重剪:去掉开头 10 秒,再调换顺序
say.note: 会复制成多个 clip 元素并设定源区间与排序。

say.text: 这是 Figma 链接,按导出的组件做一张静态标题卡
say.note: 会先运行 /figma 导出资源再构建。

howto.what_en: Authors or edits custom HyperFrames video compositions — multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes. It writes BRIEF.md, then plans scenes and loads media/animation references before building in order.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits, or BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Short unnarrated motion-first units use motion-graphics instead; fresh creation routes through hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make a 30-second brand reel with three scenes
say_en.note: Writes BRIEF.md and plans each scene first.

say_en.text: Re-cut this footage: drop the first 10 seconds and reorder
say_en.note: Duplicates the source into clip elements with ranges.

say_en.text: Use this Figma link to build a static title card
say_en.note: Runs /figma first to export the assets.
